title: BSB v Jenny Guan (BTAS 137575)
text:

9 Gray’s Inn Square, London WC1R 5JD 
Jenny Guan 
Called to the Bar by: Gray’s Inn, October 2022.  
Type of hearing: 5 Person Disciplinary Tribunal. 
Date of decision: 24 April 2026.  
Charges:   
Charge 3a  
 
Statement of Offence 
 
Professional misconduct, contrary to Core Duty 3 of the Code of Conduct of the Bar of 
England and Wales (9th Edition, Version 4.7).  
 
Particulars of Offence 
 
Jenny Guan, an unregistered barrister, who was a Second Six Pupil at the time of the 
conduct, acted dishonestly by knowingly misleading or attempting to mislead her pupil 
supervisor when she, in an email at or around 16.48 on 29 November 2023, in response 
to a request from her pupil supervisor, provided a redacted copy of her draft advice that 
she had apparently sent to her peer, a barrister external to her Chambers but omitted to 
explain that this was a copy of the document which she had recreated after her pupil 
supervisor’s request, rather than the original which was sent to her peer.  
 
Charge 4a  
 
Statement of Offence 
 
Professional misconduct, contrary to Core Duty 3 of the Code of Conduct of the Bar of 
England and Wales (9th Edition, Version 4.7).  
 

2 
Particulars of Offence 
 
Jenny Guan, an unregistered barrister, who was a Second Six Pupil at the time of the 
conduct, acted dishonestly by knowingly misleading or attempting to mislead her pupil 
supervisor when, in conversation with her pupil supervisor on 30 November 2023,  
 
a. she stated that she had not sent any other work to her peer, a barrister external 
to her Chambers, or anyone else 
 
when she had shared other documents externally and the draft advice, she provided her 
pupil supervisor on request was not the original sent to her peer.  
 
Findings: 
Charge 1 
Dismissed 
Charge 2a 
Dismissed 
Charge 2b 
Dismissed 
Charge 3a 
Admitted 
Charge 3b 
Dismissed 
Charge 4a 
Charge 4a (a) proved, rest of charge 
dismissed.  
Charge 4b 
Dismissed 
 
Sanction: 
The Respondent is not to be issued with a practicing certificate for a period of two years 
effective from 24 April 2026.  
Immediate Order- no practising certificate to be issued to the Respondent pending any 
appeal.  
Costs ordered in the sum of £3,540 payable to the BSB.
panel_members: His Honour Nicholas Ainley  (Chair) Ms Helen Compton Mr Robert Earl Ms Melissa West Mr Stephen Dann
summary: On 24 April 2026 the Tribunal ordered that the BSB not issue Ms Guan with a practising certificate for 2 years. The BSB are also not to issue a practising certificate pending any appeal. Costs: £3,540 payable to the BSB
